fields.description: Akala brings branded residences and a hotel together between DIFC and Downtown Dubai. Two towers share spaces for swimming, fitness and relaxation, while apartment layouts range from one-bedroom homes to large penthouses.

sources.label: Akala: developer price and current payment plan
Akala: official hotel and residences website

overview: Arada’s May 2025 launch describes 534 branded homes across two 220-metre towers, alongside a hotel. This is the development-wide programme, not a count of unsold apartments.
The private-residence range includes The Elements, The Collections, The Gravity House, The Sky Terrace and The Observatory. The layouts below come from Residences 1’s original brochure.
research.locationNote: The developer places Akala between DIFC and Downtown Dubai, between Index Tower and Central Park Towers. Property Finder lists Zabeel 2; district boundaries were not independently confirmed.
research.priceNote: The developer displays AED 3.79 million, rather than a unit-specific quotation. Property Finder’s separate launch guide is AED 3,905,000 and marks developer stock sold out; confirm current availability.
research.paymentNote: Current developer terms are 10% down, 50% during construction and 40% on handover. Property Finder instead records 5/35/60. The table follows the current primary page; request the selected unit’s dated calendar.
research.handoverNote: Arada’s May and July 2025 releases target completion by end-2029. This remains a forecast; the reviewed sources do not establish a completed handover.

facts.value: LEED Gold and WELL Silver precertification, as announced in May 2025.

facts.label: Observatory historical sale
facts.value: Arada announced an AED 125 million sale on 3 July 2025; not a current asking price or available home.

unresolved: Residences 1 areas include balconies; the Observatory total includes its roof terrace and must not be doubled.
The brochure’s three-bedroom A components total 240.32 m², versus its printed 240.31 m². The Observatory components total 2,199.26 m², versus 2,199.27 m².
Verify approved unit areas, furnishing, service and membership costs, parking, title and availability. Marketing services do not establish an included contractual entitlement.
